mu_name_from: The Dungeon's object slot 17, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, from MuMain, decoded under a dn_ prefix.
why_this_one: A draped cobweb, 43 of them: steel_02.tga's alpha is long web strands hanging from one corner and fanning down, on a 1.8 by 2.9 m sheet hung from the walls by the dragon heads and tilted outwards 40 degrees (MU's own placement). Read as fire from the dragon heads while it was a cutout, which made the strands chalky rags.
additive_from: A departure, marked. MU draws cobweb.tga and steel_02.tga alpha-blended; this engine has an opaque cutout or an added glow and nothing between, and as cutouts the threads stood full bright and solid (the user, 2026-09-30: 'spider webs look very light, they need to be more transparent'). So each is its own sheet premultiplied by its alpha and dimmed (cobweb 0.4; steel_02 at full, its strands being finer, after 0.55 all but hid it) into dn_*_glow.png, and added: black adds nothing, and a thread over the dark reads as a faint silver line with the room behind it.
